notes: turbothemes is vendored in vendor/turbothemes (scripts/sync-themes.mjs refreshes it) because pnpm cannot fetch the themes/ sub-folder from every environment; apps still get newer themes at run time. Modules in use: appearance (picker, theme start), release-pipeline (auto-pr, check, release), updaters (electron/updater.ts, debInstall.ts, updateErrors.ts, Updates card in About; no GitHub-token field because the repo is public), logos (emblem `load`, colour #2fd27a). window-frame (opt-in theme-drawn title bar; single-instance was already there; no GPU-mode/Discord parts) and guides-and-docs (Guides tab over docs/guides + README, markdown.ts verbatim) are copied. Everything the engine marks mandatory for a desktop app is now in. The bundle format in docs/FORMAT.md is this app's own (backup-bundle is the pattern, not the code). Core is a plain TS package with no Electron dependency.
